reviews.snippet:
The hospital is very clean, well-maintained, and has a modern setup. From the reception to the consultation rooms, everything feels professional and hygienic. Waiting areas are also comfortable.

👨‍⚕️ Doctors & Staff – 4.5/5

The ophthalmologists here are highly qualified and experienced. They explain the condition and treatment clearly, with patience. Staff are polite, though at times a bit slow during busy hours. But overall, they handle patients well.

⏱️ Waiting Time – 3.5/5

If you walk in without an appointment, be prepared to wait, especially in peak hours. Booking in advance is highly recommended. Some branches handle the crowd better than others.

💸 Pricing & Transparency – 4/5

Consultation and treatment charges are on the slightly higher side, but the quality justifies it. They’re transparent about the cost before procedures, which is a plus.

👓 Treatment Quality – 5/5

Be it cataract surgery, LASIK, or basic eye checkups – they use advanced equipment and follow proper protocols. Post-treatment care is also good.
